title: Desk Ruling: Personal Loan Standing and the FlexLine Repayment Term
content:
**Ruling.** When a borrower closes a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line to new draws while a balance remains, months are added to the term over which the balance is repaid according to the borrower's Larkspur Personal Loans.

When the borrower has an active personal loan with an amount past due of 0.00 and the largest scheduled installment payment ever posted on the borrower's personal loans is 300.00 USD or more, 6 months are added; when the borrower has such a current active personal loan and that largest installment is below 300.00 USD, 3 months are added; with no active personal loan whose amount past due is 0.00, nothing is added. Months added here count toward the term before any months are taken off it.

**Records read.** The borrower's Personal Loans: each loan's status and amount past due, and the payment entries posted on any of the borrower's personal loans that are scheduled installment payments (any date, any of the borrower's loans). Other kinds of personal-loan payment do not count toward the largest installment.

## Decision table

| Active personal loan with 0.00 past due | Largest scheduled installment ever posted | Months added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 300.00 USD or more | 6 |
| Yes | below 300.00 USD | 3 |
| No | any | 0 |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- Largest scheduled installment exactly 300.00 USD, active loan current: 6 months.
- Largest scheduled installment 299.99 USD, active loan current: 3 months.
- The borrower's only active personal loan has an amount past due above 0.00: no active personal loan with 0.00 past due, so nothing is added, whatever the installment history.
- The borrower's personal loans are all paid off or closed: nothing is added.
